entities.name: Çatalhöyük
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: One of the world's earliest large settlements (c. 7,500–5,700 BCE) in southern Turkey, housing up to 10,000 people. A key example of early urban life with dense housing, wall paintings, and communal rituals.
